malformedOutput.syntheticProviderBehavior: assistant prose without the SDK structured-output tool call
malformedOutput.adapterBehavior: propagates the SDK failure; does not parse arbitrary prose

retryBehavior.note: The SDK supports retry strategies, but MP-01 disables them in this bounded adapter. The SDK's structured-output protocol made a second model turn to request structured output before throwing; this is not a Moirae retry.

conversationState.regressionEvidence: two fixture calls created two model instances; each saw one user request only
